ai.title: Ignore GHA OIDC credentials
ai.summary: Added `gha-creds-*.json` to `.gitignore` to exclude short-lived GitHub OIDC credentials generated for the IntentBuff runner. Prevents accidental commit of ephemeral auth tokens. Change scoped to repository hygiene via `.gitignore`.

eli5.text: The system now keeps a certain type of temporary login token out of the shared project storage, so those short-lived credentials can't accidentally get saved or sent somewhere they shouldn't. If you looked at the project's ignore list, you would see a new line that tells the system to leave those tokens alone. This only affects people working behind the scenes on the project, and it is live today.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: imprezia-client
entries.summary: Shared/Core changes across 1 file(s) (+75/−48).

ai.title: Imprezia client forwards end-user IP via X-Forwarded-For
ai.summary: Adds optional `clientIp` parameter to `postToImprezia`, `fetchImpreziaChatAd`, and `fetchImpreziaDisplayAd` in `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`. The value is sent as `X-Forwarded-For` header, ensuring Imprezia targets and measures off the single end-user IP resolved by the server's proxy-aware resolver, never the raw chain. Scope limited to shared core ad client utilities. Detail: Header injection is conditional (`...(clientIp ? { 'X-Forwarded-For': clientIp } : {})`), preventing empty header spam when IP is unavailable.

eli5.text: When you use the platform, the ad-delivery system now passes your real IP address through to its partner so that off-site targeting and measurement treat it as a single, trusted user address rather than the raw chain of forwarding addresses. This only applies to the shared core ad-request utility, and the header is only added when a clean IP is actually available, so nothing changes when one can't be determined.

entries.title: CLI update: sponsored-proposal-block
entries.summary: New files: `common/src/ads/sponsored-procedure-inputs.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-cta.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-run-outcomes.ts`.

ai.title: Advertiser CTA and runtime inputs ship for sponsored runs
ai.summary: Sponsored procedures now receive the campaign landing URL carrying the signed bfcid conversion token as a runtime input, appended as a separate non-hashed prompt section when the procedure declares the {{advertiserLink}} placeholder, per the COD-512 consent contract that never rewrites procedure text. The CLI renders the advertiser CTA as sanitized text via the new sponsoredAdvertiserCtaHref gate, mirroring pr_url handling, while common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-conformance.ts adds VM-29..VM-32 checks for the CTA and common/src/ads/__fixtures__/sponsored-proposal-rows.ts adds FIXTURE_ADVERTISER_CTA_URL. Separately, common/src/ads/sponsored-run-outcomes.ts adds the decision procedure that verifies staged funnel outcomes (api_key_issued, mcp_installed) against the committed diff, and common/src/constants/agentic-ad-events.ts retires pr_made via RETIRED_AGENTIC_FUNNEL_EVENT_TYPES in favor of the existing landed stage.
ai.evidence: Three new files added under common/src/ads/: sponsored-procedure-inputs.ts (defines ADVERTISER_LINK_PLACEHOLDER = '{{advertiserLink}}', procedureDeclaresAdvertiserLink, SponsoredProcedureRuntimeInputs, SPONSORED_RUNTIME_INPUTS_HEADING, sponsoredProcedureRuntimeInputsSection), sponsored-proposal-cta.ts (defines SPONSORED_CTA_TOKEN_PARAM = 'bfcid', isSignedConversionToken, SPONSORED_CTA_SETTLEMENT_STATUSES, sponsoredAdvertiserCtaUrl, sponsoredAdvertiserCtaHref, SponsoredAdvertiserCtaInput, FIXTURE_ADVERTISER_CTA_URL) , and sponsored-run-outcomes.ts (defines verifyOutcomes, detectOutcomes, SPONSORED_RUN_OUTCOMES, parseAddedLines, sponsoredOutcomeDiffRange, SPONSORED_OUTCOME_DIFF_ARGS). The CLI diffs in cli/src/utils/sponsored-agent.ts (buildSponsoredPrompt now takes runtimeInputs and appends its section after the procedure) and cli/src/utils/sponsored-proposal-block.tsx (renders openAdvertiser?.href as sanitized text for the advertiser CTA).
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server projection (activeProposal in freebuff/web/convex/ads/proposals.ts) that assembles advertiser_cta_url or the postback consumer of bfcid, and none of the changes are driven against a real seeded proposal (COD-408).

changes.what: Adds runtime input plumbing for the advertiser CTA so a declared {{advertiserLink}} placeholder is replaced by a separate, non-hashed prompt section appended after the procedure text, never rewriting the reviewed bytes.
Adds the advertiser CTA builder that composes the landing URL with the signed bfcid query parameter, gated on charged/already_clicked settlement and a shape-checked conversion token.
buildSponsoredPrompt now accepts and appends the runtime inputs section, and the proposal block renders the advertiser CTA as sanitized text under the open-advertiser action.

changes.area: common/ads and cli (view model + transport + polls)
changes.what: Threads advertiser_cta_url through the view model, the proposal fetch validator, and the poll equality check so CTA changes refresh the card.

Adds the diff-based outcome verifier for api_key_issued and mcp_installed, and retires pr_made in the funnel vocabulary in favor of landed, with readouts excluding it via RETIRED_AGENTIC_FUNNEL_EVENT_TYPES.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: freebuff-solar-promo
entries.summary: Shared/Core changes across 1 file(s) (+25/−8).

ai.title: Solar Pro 4 drops to 0 Freebucks starting Sep 9 15:49 UTC
ai.summary: A new entry was appended to `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES` in common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts, setting Solar Pro 4 to 0 Freebucks at 2026-09-09T15:49:00Z with the tagline 0 Freebucks. The array is consumed by solarOfferAt, which reverses the list and picks the first transition whose timestamp is less than or equal to the current time, so this newest entry takes precedence for sessions created after that moment. Past price transitions are preserved unchanged so historical accounting remains coherent.
ai.evidence: Added a new entry to `SOLAR_PRICE_CHANGES` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-solar-promo.ts` with `at: '2026-09-09T15:49:00Z'`, `modelId: FREEBUFF_SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL_ID`, `price: 0`, and `tagline: '0 Freebucks'`, and expanded the comment to state transitions must be replayed in reverse timestamp order.

entries.title: CLI update: use-freebuff-session
entries.summary: CLI, Shared/Core changes across 3 file(s) (+45/−0).

ai.title: Desktop purchase claim states added to session admission
ai.summary: Three new admission statuses cover Desktop purchase lifecycle: `purchase_claim_released` retires a single-use claim so a fresh id is persisted before retry, while `purchase_in_use` and `purchase_capacity` surface an occupied tab and remaining capacity for a requested Desktop model. The hook's `nextDelayMs` now returns null for those statuses, so the poll loop stops spinning instead of retrying atomically checked capacity. Admission and superseded responses carry `desktopPurchases` and `desktopRefunds` arrays; the refund shape records `poolDate` so it points at the daily spend pool restored by the reversal ledger entry, and `claimInstanceIds` ties each refund to its execution claims.
ai.evidence: The diff adds two new variants, `purchase_claim_released` and `purchase_in_use` / `purchase_capacity`, to the `status` union in `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` (common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts), and makes `nextDelayMs` in cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts return null for those statuses so the poll loop does not retry them. It also adds `desktopPurchases` and `desktopRefunds` arrays to admission and superseded responses, plus new interfaces `FreebuffDesktopRefundInfo` and `FreebuffDesktopPurchaseInfo`, and a `FREEBUFF_PURCHASE_CONTINUITY_HEADER` constant in common/src/constants/freebuff-desktop-sessions.ts.
ai.migration: No action required to keep using the CLI; the new statuses and purchase/refund payloads are consumed by the Desktop client and the admission gate, which handle them without changing existing session join behavior.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side emitter for the new statuses, the Desktop client code that reads `desktopPurchases` / `desktopRefunds`, or how `FREEBUFF_PURCHASE_CONTINUITY_HEADER` is set on outbound requests.

changes.what: The next-delay helper stops retrying the three new Desktop purchase statuses by returning null.
Two new admission variants plus purchase and refund payload arrays are added to the session response shapes.
A versioned purchase continuity header constant is exported and the new claim behavior is documented as versioned opt-in.

This is behind-the-scenes maintenance to ensure ongoing reliability, not a new feature.
